conventions.units: 1 unit = 1 Melee unit (the fighter is ~11.7 units to the helmet top, 12.4 to the crest tip); glTF numbers are Melee units, not metres
conventions.authoring_axes: Blender Z-up, character faces -Y, character's left = +X
conventions.gltf_axes: glTF Y-up, character faces +Z, left = +X (Blender exporter -Y-forward -> +Z-forward; same handedness and facing as HSD model space)
conventions.frame_semantics: clip frame i is time i/60 s; one quaternion (+ location for trans/hips) key on every frame, linear interpolation; clip.frames = key count
conventions.rest_pose: A-pose, arms 38 degrees from vertical, legs straight, feet flat (soles at y=0)
conventions.rotation: quaternions, never euler; no bone scale anywhere (scale channels are constant 1)
conventions.root_motion: only on the `trans` bone, only in the clips flagged root_motion=true; all other clips are in place
conventions.ground: y=0 in glTF space (soles); `trans` origin is at the feet
conventions.hit_timing: hit_frames[] are clip frames equal to the Striker's script frames; author the overlays at ANIM_RATE 1.0

ecb.notes: Diamond ECB. Standing top is just above the helmet (11.7), below the crest (12.4); sampled from the animation root, not from bones. Values are proposals sized to this body (retail ECBs are a few units wide).
